title: Juventud loses his mask and pursues Jericho
summary: Chris Jericho demands Juventud Guerrera’s mask as the price of a championship opportunity. After losing it, Juventud continues chasing the champion who humiliated him.

chapters.title: Jericho takes Juventud’s mask
chapters.result: Jericho defeats Guerrera in the title-versus-mask match.
chapters.context: The challenger must unmask, making the defeat more significant than an ordinary lost title shot.

chapters.title: Juventud wins the championship
chapters.result: Guerrera defeats Jericho for the Cruiserweight title.
chapters.context: With Malenko as referee, Juventud finally takes the championship from the rival who cost him his mask.
